name: Netotte Megami!
source:
Being saved by a girl named Arne, the amnesic protagonist try to recover.
But one day, a god hero named [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/V%C3%AD%C3%B0arr]Vidar[/url], looking for a being called Fenrir, threaten to destroy all towns on his way until he get his target out of hiding.
The protagonist try to oppose him, but don't have the power.

His only chance is to try to get on his side the 3 goddess that accompany Vidar.
translation:
失忆的主人公被名叫阿尔内的少女救下，正试图恢复记忆。
但一天，寻找芬里尔的神英雄[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/V%C3%AD%C3%B0arr]维达尔[/url]威胁说，若目标不现身，他便会毁灭沿途所有城镇。
主人公想阻止他，却没有足够的力量。

他唯一的机会，是设法让跟随维达尔的三名女神站到自己一边。
